propositions: rebar-debug skill must record the originating ticket (caused_by link) before closing a bug to enable defect escape rate measurement
The current blame fallback derivation fails when the fix site differs from the cause site, particularly in unmet-obligation cases where a producer change is not propagated to consumers

The skill must execute an attribution step in Phase 1 Stage 3 that blames exact implicated lines, walks carrier commits, detects producer-consumer mismatches via date analysis, and recovers the ticket from the introducing commit
The bug close must include --caused-by flag with the identified origin ticket even when the link was pre-recorded via rebar link, to prevent derive_caused_by from adding a second guessed edge
Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees via make worktree name=<branch> to provision virtualenv, and run commands with worktree venv on PATH to satisfy pre-commit hooks
